previewResult.resultIdentity: plan-derived id only; not unique per request

consumers.queryResultBufferRunId: caller run ID is added after execution, but is not echoed by or cryptographically bound to executor result content

scenarios.finding: Coordinator run IDs can suppress stale UI state locally, but neither request nor executor result carries the run token; result IDs collide when plan IDs match.
Origin is absent from the executor result identity and cannot be correlated from SQL.
Restriction-set identity is absent from request and result contracts.
No retry-of token or attempt identity is carried.
ExecutionRunCoordinator rejects stale completion in the active component closure, but the result itself cannot prove which request produced it.
No unique result identity or delivery identity exists.
Source hash is not carried or echoed.
No shared immutable request/result identity is required by chart and BA inputs.
Abort and generation checks can suppress local state, but result cancellation generation is absent.
DuckDBPreviewResult does not expose the caller run token.

minimumFutureCorrelationContract.identityRule: Use an explicit caller-created opaque requestToken for each attempt plus deterministic governed fingerprints. SQL, source identity, timestamps and mutable counters are never sufficient alone.
retryCancellationRules: Every attempt receives a unique requestToken and shares requestRootToken with its retry chain.
retryOfToken identifies the immediately preceding attempt.
A consumer accepts only the current non-canceled generation and exact governed fingerprint tuple.
Duplicate resultIdentity delivery is idempotently ignored.
A source hash or governed fingerprint mismatch fails closed.
